schema_cleanup_sql: See PHASE1_SCHEMA_CLEANUP.sql - Execute in order: (1) backfill snake_case from camelCase where NULL, (2) DROP duplicate columns, (3) ADD missing FKs, (4) ADD/recreate indexes.
firebase_to_supabase_insert_sql: See PHASE2_FIREBASE_INSERT.sql - Prerequisite: PHASE1 applied, firebase_staging schema populated. Execute after creating firebase_staging and loading Firebase export.
staging_schema_sql: See FIREBASE_STAGING_SCHEMA.sql - Create firebase_staging schema and tables before populating from Firebase export.

firebase_export_to_staging.companies: Firebase companies collection → firebase_staging.companies (id, name, created_at)
firebase_export_to_staging.users: Firebase users collection → firebase_staging.users (id, email, company_id, role, profile_id, status, created_at, disabled, approved, superuser)
firebase_export_to_staging.sites: Firebase sites collection → firebase_staging.sites (id, company_id, name, created_at, assigned_users, rams_version, main_contractor_id, location, geofence, latitude, longitude, radius_meters)
firebase_export_to_staging.attendance: Firebase attendance collection → firebase_staging.attendance (id, user_id, site_id, company_id, action, timestamp, latitude, longitude, accuracy, email)
firebase_export_to_staging.siteRules: Firebase siteRules/{companyId} docs → firebase_staging.site_rules_docs (company_id, rules jsonb array)

id_mapping.when_firebase_id_differs_from_supabase: Create firebase_id_mapping table: (firebase_id text, supabase_id uuid) for users/sites if Firebase doc IDs do not match existing Supabase UUIDs. Use firebase_uid column on users for Auth UID.
id_mapping.preserve_supabase_test_data: ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING on companies, users, sites. WHERE NOT EXISTS on child tables. No UPDATE that overwrites.

migration_completed: 2026-02-15 - Phase 1 (schema cleanup), firebase_staging creation, and Phase 2 (INSERT) executed. No Firebase JSON files were present; staging tables were empty. Existing Supabase data preserved. RLS policies updated for canonical columns.
execution_order: 2. Execute PHASE1_SCHEMA_CLEANUP.sql (backfill, drop dupes, add FKs, indexes)
3. Export Firebase data to JSON/CSV using Firebase Admin export or custom script
5. Populate firebase_staging tables from Firebase export (transform timestamps to ISO8601 or epoch)
7. Validate: row counts, FK integrity, spot-check key records
notes: No destructive operations included - no DELETE, no TRUNCATE
All Supabase test data preserved via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and WHERE NOT EXISTS
All Firebase IDs preserved as UUIDs where document ID is used
All duplicate columns resolved safely - backfill before drop
Firestore Timestamp: export as epoch seconds (numeric) or ISO8601 string; regex ~ '^\d+$' detects epoch
Arrays and nested objects: export as JSON text, cast to jsonb in INSERT
site_rules: Firebase has one doc per company with rules[] array; transform to one row per rule
assigned_operatives: Firebase doc ID = operativeId; Supabase needs generated uuid for id column
site_subcontractors: Composite PK (site_id, company_id); no separate id
pre_induction_*: ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING preserves existing Supabase pre-induction data
briefing_acknowledgements: Add FK to briefings in Phase 1 before migration
Optional: Add firebase_id_mapping table if Firebase and Supabase use different ID schemes
